title: console: the grid, kanban, calendar and gantt record drawers mount the one record page (embedded `RecordDetailView`) instead of the quick-look `RecordDetailPanel` / `DetailView` path — one record rendering, the drawer stack and tiers everywhere
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

**Premise corrected by `domain:ui#1` (comment 6495422396):** the renderers mount `NavigationOverlay` + `RecordDetailPanel` inline, not `RecordDetailDrawer`; in the console grid and kanban already reach the embedded page, calendar and gantt suppress the host click. Target unchanged; Source and Acceptance read through that comment.

Unblocked 2026-10-29T09:07Z — upstream #26679, #27055 closed (the record page v3 layout and its round 2 are on `main` at `273137d227`; #27053's `tabs` retirement and #26679's drawer are there too). Back in the ui lane queue; re-read the card's Source against current `main` at dispatch — the v3 files it names moved in PR #27310 / #27473.

Part of the record-page-v3 epic #26676 (v3 child 5 of 8). Runs after #26679's PR lands (drawer stack) and after #27055.

## Source (origin/main `7bb8084590`)

`RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` (plugin-detail) renders `RecordDetailPanel` → `DetailView` through `NavigationOverlay` for `ObjectGrid`, `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectGantt` (and `ListView` / `ObjectDataTable` quick-look), a second rendering of a record with `DEFAULT_SYSTEM_FIELDS`, no page assignment, no related lists, no column tiers, no drawer stack. The console's `ObjectView` drawer mounts `RecordDetailView embedded` — the page itself. So the same object opens two different records depending on the visualization that was clicked (ruling 1: one page at two widths).

## Target

1. The four renderers' drawers mount the embedded record page: `RecordDetailDrawer` becomes a thin host that renders the page the console provides through a host channel (the renderers are router-free; the console passes a `renderRecord(objectName, id)` host prop, as it passes `recordLinkAdornment` today), falling back to the current `RecordDetailPanel` only when no host provides a page (non-console hosts). Inside the console there is one record rendering.
2. The drawer stack (#26679) and the column tiers apply in those drawers for free; the reader's record-open preference (drawer | split) applies to kanban / calendar / gantt rows the same as to grid rows.
3. `RecordDetailPanel` / `DetailView` stay as the non-console fallback for now; mark them with a docblock naming this card and the retirement path (ADR-0049); no tombstone in this card (follow-up once the fallback measures zero callers).

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`, `RecordDetailPanel.tsx` (docblock only), `ui/packages/plugin-{grid,kanban,calendar,gantt}/src/*.tsx` (the host prop plumb), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` / `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (passing the page renderer), `ui/packages/react` host context if a new channel is needed, tests beside, changesets.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a kanban card click in the console mounts `RecordDetailView embedded` (not `DetailView`); outside the console the fallback still renders; the drawer stack's trail works from a calendar event.
2. Screenshots: HotCRM opportunities kanban → card → drawer with the v3 header and tabs; calendar event → drawer.

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>
